en: Jose Rizal was executed by firing squad in the open field of Bagumbayan, not inside a prison.
Marcela Agoncillo and her daughter Lorenza, not Emilio Aguinaldo, sewed the first official Philippine flag in Hong Kong.
Philippine Independence Day was originally celebrated on July 4 until President Diosdado Macapagal changed it to June 12 in 1962.
The traditional Barong Tagalog is made of sheer piña fiber to prove the wearer is not hiding a weapon.
While Filipino is the national language, the Philippines actually has over 170 distinct regional languages like Cebuano and Ilocano.
The judicial branch, led by the Supreme Court, interprets laws and judges cases, while the executive branch enforces them.
The 1987 Philippine Constitution strictly limits the President to a single six-year term without the possibility of re-election.
Filipino scientist Gregorio Zara invented the two-way videophone and an alcohol-fueled engine, but he did not invent the internet.
Traditional Bahay Kubo houses use lightweight bamboo and nipa palm leaves on stilts to allow typhoon winds to pass through safely.
Lapu-Lapu and his warriors defeated Magellan using indigenous weapons like bamboo spears, iron-tipped arrows, and kampilan swords, not European firearms.
Registered Filipino citizens can vote in national elections once they reach the legal voting age of 18, not 21.
Andres Bonifacio founded the Katipunan as a secret armed revolutionary society, not a peaceful political party formed by Jose Rizal.
